subject: Security gates & timeline for Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Alice Lee <alice.lee@fintechcorp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security gates for Redwood eval and procurement

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Before we proceed with a pilot and procurement, security and legal need a clear plan for the evaluation: specifically SOC 2 evidence, a completed SIG/CAIQ matrix, an initial DPA draft, and confirmation of data retention and deletion practices for logs and KV cache.

High level ask: can you share a proposed timeline (MAP) that maps those gates to evaluation milestones? We have a board meeting end of June and would like procurement signed by 6/30 if feasible.

A few clarifying questions up front:
- Is your SOC 2 in-scope for hosting/infra or just your control plane?
- What is your standard data retention for audit logs and request metadata? Can it be shortened for pilot customers?
- Do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments?

We're happy to share our information security checklist if that helps. Would like a short call to align on scope — available Thu 5/14 afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Alice Lee
Head of InfoSec, FinTechCorp
-----
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lee <alice.lee@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security gates for Redwood eval and procurement

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (redwood-map-proposed.xlsx) that maps evaluation milestones to the security/compliance gates you called out. Quick summary below and next steps.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Week 0 (kickoff): NDA + access request; confirm point-of-contact for security and legal.
- Week 1: Provide SOC 2 report summary + redwood-soc2-evidence.zip (control descriptions, auditor letter).
- Week 1–2: SIG/CAIQ submission and walkthrough (we attach redwood-caiaq-response.xlsx).
- Week 2: DPA draft shared (redwood-dpa-draft-20260514.pdf) — includes data retention and deletion clauses.
- Week 3: Security deep-dive call and remediation log; final legal redlines.
- Week 4: Pilot onboarding; production readiness checklist and 30-day pilot.

Answers to your clarifying questions:
- SOC 2: Our Type II covers the Redwood control plane and key hosted components; we include a scope statement in the evidence bundle. For Dedicated/Private deployments, additional attestation language is provided in the DPA.
- Data retention: default request/usage logs are retained 365 days; audit logs (control-plane) are retained 730 days. For pilots we can provide a scoped retention configuration down to 90 days for request metadata — requires a brief architecture note and a signed commitment in the MAP.
- KMS/HSM: supported for Private deployments (customer-managed KMS integration). Hosted customers can use our KMS with customer-specific key wrapping; HSM-backed keys are available via dedicated-region options.

Next steps I propose:
1) Security walkthrough — Thu 5/14 at 3pm PT (we've penciled this in; send calendar invite).
2) You review the attached MAP + DPA and flag legal redlines by Tue 5/19.
3) If green, run pilot onboarding Week of 5/25.

Attachments: redwood-map-proposed.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates), redwood-soc2-evidence.zip, redwood-caiaq-response.xlsx, redwood-dpa-draft-20260514.pdf

If you'd like to accelerate any piece, let us know which gates you'd like prioritized and we'll rearrange the MAP.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
-----
From: Alice Lee <alice.lee@fintechcorp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@fintechcorp.com>, security@fintechcorp.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security gates for Redwood eval and procurement

Neha — this is helpful, thanks. A couple of follow ups after an internal sync:

1) Timeline — we need to try to compress the plan by one week for board timing (procurement by 6/30 still possible if pilot starts 5/18). Can you make Week 1 deliverables available by 5/15 EOD?

2) Data retention — the 90-day option for pilot is acceptable, but Legal wants explicit deletion guarantees: after pilot ends, request-level data (non-PII) must be deletable on request within 5 business days and we need deletion certificates. Can Redwood provide deletion certificates?

3) DPA / regulatory clause — we have a mandated clause around data locality and a strict log retention window for crypto-related workflows. I'll attach our legal snippet in a separate email.

4) SOC 2 scope — please confirm whether our pilot will be covered by your existing SOC 2 (if using hosted API) or if we need a Letter of Attestation for pilot-specific controls.

We'll join the walkthrough Thu 5/14 3pm PT. I'll send a calendar invite to confirm.

Thanks,
Alice

Alice — looping in a short leadership note. We can accommodate an accelerated MAP but need two commitments to do so safely: 1) FinTechCorp agrees to the scoped pilot retention/config in writing (we'll add to the MAP), and 2) Legal provides redline turnaround within 48 hours once we share the DPA.

Operational concessions we're offering to hit your procurement timeline:
- Priority delivery of SOC 2 evidence (we'll separate the most relevant control narratives in <48 hours).
- Dedicated security owner for the FinTechCorp engagement (contact: karthik_security@redwood.com).
- One-time pilot credit and an SLA exception for latency SLOs during pilot (internal approval already in place).

Regarding deletion certificates: we can provide an automated deletion record (timestamped export of deleted object ids and retention policy applied) and sign a confirmation letter. For stricter attestation we can offer a short bespoke addendum; have your legal team flag preferred language and we will turn it around quickly.

We'll send an updated MAP (dates pushed up) and a redlined DPA for your legal to review by Tue 5/19 EOD. If that works, plan remains: pilot onboarding week of 5/25 and procurement target 6/30.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Operations
